# Sync

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A core plugin that synchronizes your files through the Obsidian Sync service.

## Scope note

- Supports sharing of Obsidian notes across multiple devices, such as macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and Windows.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
